items.source: Atomically returns and removes the first/last element (head/tail depending on the from argument) of the list stored at sourceKey, and pushes the element at the first/last element (head/tail depending on the to argument) of the list stored at destinationKey.
items.translation: 原子性地返回并移除存储在 `sourceKey` 中的列表的第一个/最后一个元素（取决于 `from` 参数是 head/tail），并将存储在 `destinationKey` 中的列表的第一个/最后一个元素（取决于 `to` 参数是 head/tail）推入该列表。

items.source: Get indices of the element from list at ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey().
items.translation: 获取列表元素在ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey()处的索引。

items.source: Removes and returns last element in list stored at ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey()
items.translation: 移除并返回存储在ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey()中的列表的最后一个元素。

items.source: Remove the last element from list at source, append it to destination and return its value.
items.translation: 从源列表移除最后一个元素，将其追加到目标列表并返回其值。

items.source:
Removes and returns the top ReactiveListCommands.BPopCommand.getDirection() element from lists stored at ReactiveListCommands.BPopCommand.getKeys().
Blocks connection until element available or ReactiveListCommands.BPopCommand.getTimeout() reached.
items.translation:
从存储在ReactiveListCommands.BPopCommand.getKeys()的列表中移除并返回位于顶部（由ReactiveListCommands.BPopCommand.getDirection()指定）的元素。
阻塞连接，直到有可用元素或达到ReactiveListCommands.BPopCommand.getTimeout()。

items.source: Removes the ReactiveListCommands.LRemCommand.getCount() occurrences of ReactiveListCommands.LRemCommand.getValue() from the list stored at ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey().
items.translation: 从存储在 ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey() 的列表中，移除 ReactiveListCommands.LRemCommand.getCount() 个值为 ReactiveListCommands.LRemCommand.getValue() 的元素。

items.source: Result for ReactiveListCommands.PopCommand/ReactiveListCommands.BPopCommand.
items.translation: 结果为 ReactiveListCommands.PopCommand/ReactiveListCommands.BPopCommand。

items.source: Get element at ReactiveListCommands.LIndexCommand.getIndex() form list at ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey().
items.translation: 获取列表中的元素，该列表位于ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey()处，索引由ReactiveListCommands.LIndexCommand.getIndex()提供。

items.source: Insert value RedisListCommands.Position.BEFORE or RedisListCommands.Position.AFTER existing pivot for key.
items.translation: 插入值到 key 的现有枢轴之前或之后，具体位置为 RedisListCommands.Position.BEFORE 或 RedisListCommands.Position.AFTER。

items.source: Get elements in ReactiveRedisConnection.RangeCommand.getRange() from list at ReactiveRedisConnection.KeyCommand.getKey()
